body:
Part of #13588 — half **A** of the two ruled halves. Half C is reported separately; this PR does not carry it.

⛔ **Draft on purpose, and it stays draft.** `.claude/**` is a governed surface: human merge only. Never flip to ready, never enqueue.

## What the adjudication says

Maintainer, 2026-08-31, 第 6 场总监席决裁批 #12, verbatim 「同意」. Quoted rather than paraphrased, because the exceptions are the load-bearing half:

> **A(纳入,判据收窄)**:published `skills/**` 中**作出可证伪的算子/契约语义主张**的改动落入条款② CONTENT 肢 ⇒ 该 PR 挂 `needs:contract-review` 走复审链(标签时序照旧遵守 2026-08-28 不预挂裁定:PR 存在的同笔挂)。**判据是「可证伪的语义主张」,⛔ 不是「提到契约」**——纯算子清单、拼写、格式改动不触发(#13539 实测:10 处命中仅 3 处有主张,即为标尺)。受管面人工合并照旧,两道保障叠加不互替。

> **执行落点**:A 半是 skill/SOP 文本变更(受管面,skills 车道,draft + 人工合并;条款②细则单源 `references/contract-review.md` 的适用性段同笔补一句)

## The change

One bullet, three lines, at the head of `载体纪律(挂与清)` in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` — the ruled single source. It carries all four load-bearing parts of the ruling: the scope (published `skills/**`), the narrowed criterion (可证伪的算子/契约语义主张), the explicit ⛔ negative (not 「提到契约」; operator lists, spelling and formatting do not trigger), and the 10-hits/3-claims yardstick. Provenance is dated in the text.

Attach **timing** is deliberately not restated: the adjacent bullet directly below is the 2026-08-28 不预挂 ruling, which already governs it. One rule, one home.

## Why the ceiling moves 48 → 51, and what was tried first

`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` holds this file at **48 lines, headroom 0**. Its own discipline: *"RAISING one requires a maintainer ruling quoted in the raising PR's body… A protocol change that would cross a ceiling pays its way by moving narrative out (SKILL.md → references/) or compressing in place, instead of raising the roof."* The ruling above is that evidence, and here is why neither in-place route was available:

- **Moving narrative out is not available.** This *is* the references file; the only direction left is SKILL.md, which is the wrong direction and out of scope.
- **Compressing in place would be re-wrap funding.** Measured on this file: 41 content lines, 577 bytes of total slack under the 120-byte cap, mean width 105.9/120. The addition is 332 bytes. Absorbing it without a new line means re-wrapping the whole file — refused per the 2026-08-17 rule, exactly as recorded on the `dispatch-runbook.md` entry in the same map.
- **The only other in-place payment was deleting a ruled clause** — refused on the `state-machine.md` precedent in the same map (43 → 44, same shape: one ruled addition, no payment available, landed count, headroom 0).

The raise lands at the landed count with **headroom 0 again**, same convention as every neighbouring entry, and the CEILINGS comment carries the measurement so it is checkable without re-deriving it.

## Measured, not assumed

- The file is **51 lines**, every line **≤ 120 bytes** (the gate's own `wrapLine` did the wrapping). Gate verdict lines, quoted from the gate:
  - `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md is 51 lines (ceiling 51; headroom 0).`
  - `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md: widest table row is 0 bytes (pin 0; headroom 0).`
- **No published `skills/**` file is touched**, so the published-bundle line/token readings do not apply to this diff. The edited skill root is `.claude/skills/**`, priced in LINES by the ratchet above — which is exactly the reading reported here.

## Gates

Derived from the REAL diff with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` in a fresh worktree (not from a hand-written path list), and run at the final commit `b812c180`. 20 commands, exit code captured before any pipe:

- **19 green (exit 0)**, including `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `check:parse-guard`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:pnpm-filter-targets`, `check:cli-command-ids`, `check:bash32-floor`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-cross-package-test-inputs`, `check-shard-attestation`, `bare-root-worklist --self-test`.
- **1 NOT MEASURED**: `node scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs` exits **3** with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` — it grades a saved `turbo run test` log that only CI produces. Its own output states this is *"not a red, and there is nothing here to fix"*. Recorded as NOT MEASURED, not as green and not as red.
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` green separately (standing rule for any edit): `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 7572 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)`.
- Because this diff edits a **gate script**, that script's own suite was run rather than only its derived family. `check-skill-line-ratchet --self-test` passes (it is the script's test suite — there is no separate `*.test.ts` for it). The three other gates in the tree that read this script by name were then enumerated by `git grep` and run directly, since the path derivation names only one of them: `check:pm-dispatch-gates` **exit 0**, `node scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` **exit 0**, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` **exit 0** (`✓ 38 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`).

## Changeset

None, deliberately. The diff is `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**` only — nothing publishes from any package — so it is on the closed `skip-changeset` list, and that label is applied in the same stroke as this PR rather than after a red Check Changeset.

## One thing this PR does NOT close, reported rather than fixed

The two-limb (双肢) definition itself lives in `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, which is **out of scope** for this card (fable-mandated face under its own line ratchet), and its clause-② gate paragraph routes readers here only for *载体纪律、资格与归属、降档保险丝* — applicability is not among the three topics it names. The criterion is reachable in practice, because the operative half of the ruling is an attach rule and 载体纪律 is exactly where an attaching seat lands. But a reader who consults only SKILL.md's 双肢 paragraph will not see the `skills/**` face named. Closing that gap needs a SKILL.md edit; flagged here for the PM to route, not taken.
